question: Within original GPS source strata shared by two animal taxa, do observed differences in solar-relative travel headings coexist with differences in 100 m wind-relative travel and weather-derived incident shortwave radiation? Is the solar-wind geometry itself different at taxa's sampled hours?
source_selection: All TWO original source archives supporting at least one pair in the prior locked ten-source original multi-taxon common-cell analysis; source IDs frozen AFTER solar-bearing group outcomes, BEFORE any weather values opened. Explicit exploratory, not an independent prospective validation.
gps_requirements: Reproduce original fixed 1° floor latitude+longitude × original solar calendar year-month × 4-hour apparent solar-clock grouping, at least 3 tagged animals, 3 dates and 15 steps per taxon-cell, >=3 overlapping cells per pair; original GPS 30–120min adjacent interval, >=0.1km move, <=60km/h, sun elevation>=10 at both ends and midpoint. Reproduce all four original pair-specific R_A-R_B values and eligible shared cell counts EXACTLY before ANY weather API is called. Provider original UUID/size/MD5 must match frozen manifest.
weather_provider: Open-Meteo historical archive public ERA5 hourly; SOURCE MODEL explicitly era5, not Best Match or forecast. https://open-meteo.com/en/docs/historical-weather-api
weather_requested_cells: For every original shared GPS stratum of one of the four previously supported taxon pairs, use original GPS step-midpoint 1° spatial cell center (floor(lat)+0.5, floor(lon)+0.5) and UTC YEAR, request full Jan 1–Dec 31 hourly weather for the exact observed cell×year set (not selectively favorable dates).
clock_hour_alignment: Weather hour at floor(midpoint original UTC timestamp), no local timezone guesses, no interpolation of missing weather. ERA5 shortwave_radiation is preceding-hour mean; wind and T are hourly instantaneous approximations.
weather_provenance: Record SHA256 of every provider returned raw hourly JSON and approximate coverage but no exact original animal lat/lon/time or weather request URLs in published results. Previous ODSP ERA5 refetches changed some source values; weather is observational/provisional, re-fetch reproducibility not guaranteed until byte preservation/versioned public source.
wind_conventions: Meteorological wind_direction_100m is wind FROM north-clockwise; wind-flow-to bearing=(direction+180)%360. This is 100m gridded wind, NOT bird flight altitude or experienced wind.
estimands: For EACH previously supported pair, use SAME original shared GPS cells and hourly weather-matched original GPS steps. Per cell, equally weight observed GPS fixes within animal then animals within original taxon; equally weight common cells.

Original solar-relative cos(B-A) for each species, re-evaluated after weather join; original baseline mean and pair difference must replay exactly if weather coverage 100%, otherwise explicitly disclose reduced support.
Wind-flow-relative cos(B-W_to) separately for each species on identical original GPS steps, wind speed and shortwave exposure same-steps.
Potential wind-only solar-alignment geometry cos(W_to-A), which uses weather wind flow and sun but NOT GPS animal bearing; measure group weather sampling/time composition.
Cell-equal pair taxon A-minus-B differences for solar, wind and wind-sun geometry, plus observed 100m wind-speed, 2m-temperature and shortwave exposures. No p-value or new selective pair admission.

Source/taxon/year observation support and ERA5 missingness; if <90% of relevant source GPS steps matched for ANY previously supported pair, environmental paired estimate SOURCE_HOLD rather than a weather-selected result.
interpretation_ceiling: Original observational GPS heading is not animal body direction, cloud perception, selected light exposure or thermal orientation. Wind at 100m is lower-atmosphere coarse model, not local soaring wind. Shared 1° grid/month/4h clock does not establish encounter/competition, causal response or independent biomes. Original two studied landscapes selected after original bearing results; no confirmatory claims.
privacy: No event-level GPS, exact timestamp, individual ID, original grid cell coordinates or hourly weather request URLs in committed results or GitHub logs; ephemeral CI analysis only. Original source licenses respected.
technical_policy: One exact original provider checksum attempt per source. Fail closed on provider source, weather response missing, model, units, duplicate UTC hours, excessive grid-years, or reduced weather coverage; no new data or thresholds after outcome.
aim: Ecology-forward environmental triangulation to determine whether existing solar-relative species differences could reflect meteorological directional opportunities rather than direct sun selection.
